## Summary

Describe the academic use case, visual source, and intentional projection/accessibility changes.

## New-style checklist

- [ ] I worked on a branch rather than directly on `main`.
- [ ] Source, owner, license, inspection date, and adaptation decisions are documented.
- [ ] The color profile defines every Sinew token and offline font fallbacks.
- [ ] The Matplotlib overlay and gallery figure use the same data-color ordering.
- [ ] The index contains a complete style column, including citation and references slides.
- [ ] Plain `quarto render` includes every registered style without source edits or a profile argument.
- [ ] The style has its own entry in `references.bib` and a stable citation target.
- [ ] The extension version advances to the next minor development version.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, and `template/docs/styles.md` are updated.
- [ ] Static validation, contrast checks, all-style rendering, and render checks pass locally.
- [ ] I reviewed the CI gallery artifact at common and ultrawide viewport sizes.
- [ ] Divider backgrounds are full bleed on ultrawide displays and content remains inside the safe canvas.
- [ ] Code blocks, tables, references, and hover cards fit without scrollbars.
- [ ] Tables highlight only the final `Ours:` rows; baseline rows remain unhighlighted.
- [ ] Figure, table, and algorithm identifiers are bold and numbered; algorithm captions remain inside their code containers.
- [ ] Research framing uses generated Q1-Q9 and H1-H9 lists, with no more than one non-color-only primary highlight per list.
- [ ] The citation slide references its figure, table, algorithm, Q1, and H1; every link previews and navigates to the correct original target without hard-coded numbering.
- [ ] Figure, table, and algorithm fullscreen inspection works with pointer, keyboard, Escape/Close, focus return, and the active profile.
- [ ] Affiliation marks retain aspect ratio, alt text, authorization notes, and legibility across the divider backgrounds.
- [ ] No generated `_site`, private URL, protected asset, or `.beads` content is committed.

## Evidence

Add screenshots for the divider, problem, research framing, algorithm, plot, table, fullscreen inspector, citation, references, and citation-hover states.
